title: Evaluation of Fourier substitution coefficients
statement: For any $n\ge 0$ and any function $p:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, evaluating the numerical coefficient function $T\mapsto(-2)^{|T|}\sum_{S\supseteq T}\widehat p(S)$ in the squarefree indicator monomials gives the function $x\mapsto p(\operatorname{sign}(x))$ on $(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$, where $\widehat p(S)$ denotes the uniform Fourier coefficient of $p$ at $S$.
